events.name: Tropical Cyclone SIMON-26
events.severity_text: Hurricane/Typhoon > 74 mph (maximum wind speed of 231 km/h)

explain.what: Tropical Cyclone SIMON-26 is affecting Mexico.
explain.severity: Top winds reach about 231 km/h (144 mph), which makes it a Category 4 (major) hurricane/typhoon. Winds can tear roofs off homes and leave areas without power for weeks.
explain.expect: Near the coast, storm surge (sea water pushed ashore) is usually the deadliest part. Heavy rain can flood areas far from the center. The shaded zones on the map show where winds of 60, 90 and 120 km/h are forecast.
explain.alert: Red alert: severe impact is likely. International help will probably be needed.

events.name: Taal volcano

explain.what: The Taal volcano in Philippines is erupting.
explain.expect: Volcanic ash makes breathing harder, contaminates water, and can shut down airports. Mudflows can race down river valleys even far from the volcano.
explain.alert: Orange alert: significant impact is likely. The affected country may need outside help.

events.name: Tropical Cyclone CHOI-WAN-26
events.severity_text: Hurricane/Typhoon > 74 mph (maximum wind speed of 250 km/h)

explain.what: Tropical Cyclone CHOI-WAN-26 is affecting Guam.
explain.severity: Top winds reach about 250 km/h (155 mph), which makes it a Category 4 (major) hurricane/typhoon. Winds can tear roofs off homes and leave areas without power for weeks.
explain.expect: Near the coast, storm surge (sea water pushed ashore) is usually the deadliest part. Heavy rain can flood areas far from the center. The shaded zones on the map show where winds of 60, 90 and 120 km/h are forecast.
explain.alert: Green alert: limited impact expected. Local authorities can usually handle it.
